files.text:
include { KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_COUNT } from 'nf-core/kallistobustools/count'
include { KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_REF   } from 'nf-core/kallistobustools/ref'

workflow FASTQ_QUANT_KALLISTOBUSTOOLS {
    take:
    genome_fasta    // channel: [ meta, fasta ]
    gtf             // channel: [ meta, gtf ]
    kallisto_index  // value channel: prebuilt index
    txp2gene        // path: transcript-to-gene map
    t1c             // path: cDNA capture list
    t2c             // path: intron capture list
    protocol        // val: sequencing technology
    kb_workflow     // val: standard, nac, or lamanno
    ch_fastq        // channel: [ meta, [ reads ] ]

    main:
    assert (txp2gene && kallisto_index) || (genome_fasta && gtf):
        "Must provide a genome fasta file ('--fasta') and a gtf file ('--gtf') if no index is given!"

    if (!(txp2gene && kallisto_index)) {
        KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_REF( genome_fasta, gtf, kb_workflow )
        txp2gene = KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_REF.out.t2g.collect()
        kallisto_index = KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_REF.out.index.collect()
        t1c = KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_REF.out.cdna_t2c.ifEmpty{ [] }
        t2c = KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_REF.out.intron_t2c.ifEmpty{ [] }
    } else {
        kallisto_index = kallisto_index.map { index -> [[id: 'kallisto_index'], index] }
    }

    KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_COUNT(
        ch_fastq,
        kallisto_index,
        txp2gene,
        t1c,
        t2c,
        protocol,
        kb_workflow
    )

    ch_raw_counts = KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_COUNT.out.count.flatMap{ meta, kb_dir ->
        def target = file("${kb_dir.toUriString()}/counts_unfiltered")
        target.exists() ? [[meta + [input_type: 'raw'], target]] : []
    }
    ch_filtered_counts = KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_COUNT.out.count.flatMap{ meta, kb_dir ->
        def target = file("${kb_dir.toUriString()}/counts_filtered")
        target.exists() ? [[meta + [input_type: 'filtered'], target]] : []
    }

    emit:
    counts          = KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_COUNT.out.count  // channel: [ meta, count directory ]
    counts_raw      = ch_raw_counts                     // channel: [ meta, unfiltered matrix directory ]
    counts_filtered = ch_filtered_counts                // channel: [ meta, filtered matrix directory ]
    txp2gene        = txp2gene                          // path: transcript-to-gene map

}

---
name: "nf-core/fastq_quant_kallistobustools"
description: "Build a Kallisto reference when needed and quantify single-cell reads\
  \ with kb."
keywords:
- "single-cell"
- "kallisto"
- "bustools"
components:
- "kallistobustools/ref"
- "kallistobustools/count"
input:
- genome_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Genome FASTA tuple with metadata, or an empty list when using a\
      \ prebuilt reference."
- gtf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Genome annotation tuple with metadata, or an empty list when using\
      \ a prebuilt reference."
- kallisto_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Prebuilt Kallisto index as a value channel, or an empty list to\
      \ generate one."
- txp2gene:
    type: "file"
    description: "Transcript-to-gene map, or an empty list to generate one."
- t1c:
    type: "file"
    description: "cDNA capture list, or an empty list."
- t2c:
    type: "file"
    description: "Intron capture list, or an empty list."
- protocol:
    type: "string"
    description: "kb sequencing technology."
- kb_workflow:
    type: "string"
    description: "Reference and counting workflow (standard, nac, or lamanno)."
- ch_fastq:
    type: "file"
    description: "Read pairs with sample metadata."
output:
- counts:
    type: "directory"
    description: "kb count output as a tuple of sample metadata and a directory."
- counts_raw:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Unfiltered count matrix directory with sample metadata and input_type\
      \ raw."
- counts_filtered:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Filtered count matrix directory with sample metadata and input_type\
      \ filtered, when present."
- txp2gene:
    type: "file"
    description: "Supplied or generated transcript-to-gene map."
authors:
- "@atrigila"
- "@fmalmeida"
- "@grst"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/kallistobustools/count@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/kallistobustools/ref@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
